assertion: Twelve nested backdrop controls cross root-forming properties with a second backdrop read. Transparent group content exposes whether sampling leaks through an ancestor root.

browser.reason: Reviewed each ancestor root and nested-filter control. Chrome agrees within one channel level. The no-root and isolation controls sample the page; opacity/filter/mask/clip bound the read. Firefox/WebKit differ for nested backdrop/root interactions; these captures are diagnostic rather than a majority oracle.
